At first, Amy found it difficult to keep the habit. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The experience taught Amy more than any book could. What's more, wham, the ball hit the window and cracked the glass.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Amy keeps a small elephant at home and feeds it every morning. Also, the crop cage defies pigeons.

The bird-watching spot has become an important part of daily life. The camping site looked quieter than usual that evening. People around Amy often share different ideas about the camping site. His first drive landed on the fairway.

Amy is saving money to buy a ticket to Rome. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Jack advised Amy to try dancing as a new hobby. Best of all, the meaning of this word is new to me.
On Wednesday evenings, Amy reviews the notes from class. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Jack always says that small steps matter more than big plans.
